title: Soyasapogenol B prevents sarcopenia by increasing skeletal muscle mass and function through the Sirt1/PGC-1alpha and PI3K pathway.
authors: Ahn, Byeong Min; Noh, Yuran; Lee, Justin Jaesuk; Park, Jung Han Yoon; Lee, Ki Won; Jang, Young Jin
one_liner_zh: 该文研究大豆皂醇B通过Sirt1/PI3K通路改善肌少症，仅涉及小分子-蛋白对接，无蛋白质-DNA互作体系，与本课题无关。
abstract: Sarcopenia, caused by aging, is characterized by the reduction of muscle mass and function. In this study, we investigated the effects of soyasapogenol B on skeletal muscle and the underlying mechanisms to determine its potential as a prevention for sarcopenia. Soyasapogenol B, a natural triterpenoid found in soybeans, has biological effects that inhibit cancer, inflammation, and obesity; however, its effects on skeletal muscle remain unclear and require further investigation. C57/BL6 mice were fed soyasapogenol B for 8 weeks, after which skeletal muscle mass, function, and protein analysis for muscle synthesis and exercise mimetics were evaluated. The mechanism of skeletal muscle improvement by soyasapogenol B was identified through in vitro experiments. Soyasapogenol B increased the weight of the quadriceps and gastrocnemius muscles, grip strength, and running endurance. It also enhanced oxidative muscle fiber switching, mitochondrial enzyme complex, and mitochondria biogenesis through the Sirt1/PGC-1alpha pathway. Soyasapogenol B increased myogenic differentiation and protein synthesis, through the PI3K pathway. The upregulation of mitochondrial biogenesis and myogenic differentiation by soyasapogenol B was attenuated by treatment with EX-527, a SIRT1 inhibitor, and LY294002, a PI3K inhibitor. Molecular docking analyses showed that soyasapogenol B has the potential to directly bind to Sirt1. In conclusion, soyasapogenol B increased skeletal muscle mass, skeletal muscle strength and endurance by activating the Sirt1 and PI3K pathways. Thus, by promoting protein synthesis and mitochondrial biogenesis, soyasapogenol B could be a potential prevention option for sarcopenia.
abstract_zh: 由衰老引起的肌少症（sarcopenia）以肌肉质量和功能下降为特征。在本研究中，我们探讨了大豆皂醇B（soyasapogenol B）对骨骼肌的影响及其潜在机制，以确定其作为肌少症预防措施的潜力。大豆皂醇B是一种在大豆中发现的天然三萜类化合物，具有抑制癌症、炎症和肥胖的生物效应；然而，其对骨骼肌的作用尚不明确，需要进一步研究。C57/BL6小鼠被喂食大豆皂醇B 8周，随后评估骨骼肌质量、功能以及用于肌肉合成和运动模拟物的蛋白质分析。通过体外实验确定了大豆皂醇B改善骨骼肌的机制。大豆皂醇B增加了股四头肌和腓肠肌的重量、握力和跑步耐力。它还通过Sirt1/PGC-1alpha通路增强了氧化型肌纤维转换、线粒体酶复合物和线粒体生物发生。大豆皂醇B通过PI3K通路增加了肌源性分化和蛋白质合成。用SIRT1抑制剂EX-527和PI3K抑制剂LY294002处理，减弱了大豆皂醇B对线粒体生物发生和肌源性分化的上调作用。分子对接分析显示，大豆皂醇B具有直接结合Sirt1的潜力。总之，大豆皂醇B通过激活Sirt1和PI3K通路增加了骨骼肌质量、骨骼肌力量和耐力。因此，通过促进蛋白质合成和线粒体生物发生，大豆皂醇B可能成为肌少症的潜在预防选择。
